Exact top-p requires global probability ordering/cumulative mass; arbitrary custom processors can inspect or mutate a whole row; unbounded top-logprobs require global ordered output. These legal features retain the stock path.
Stock rounds the GEMM result to BF16 and applies FP32 softcap before argmax. Softcap saturation can tie unequal raw logits, so raw accumulator maxima do not preserve lowest-token selection.
